messages.subject: add density plot to an existing density plot
parts:
Hi there,

I`m a novice to ggplot and I´m really impressed what wonderful looking
graphs are feasible.
Maybe my question is beginner-like, but after browsing throug the
ggplot2-book and the excellent homepage I´m not able to create a plot
in a way I want to do. I hope, someone can help me. I created a
density plot with
m <- ggplot(sampdat[sampdat$SampScheme=="population",], aes(x=DEM))
m + geom_density(colour="darkgreen",size=2, fill="green")
And now I want to add on top of this filled density plot several other
density plots, not in a filled fashion but as lines (these additional
densityplots were subsamples from the entire population).

Any help would be great.

Thanks
TIM
